text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmm... What's wrong with meee...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Even though we went through the 
trouble of coming on a shrine date, my 
heart isn't really racing at all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Does Maya have a cold, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, Nyankichi! Not right now...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? That voice is—

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Nyaan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah—! It's a kitty and Nature-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What were you doing all the way over 
there? Playing hide-and-seek with a 
kitty??

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, well~... more like, am I getting in 
the way~? I thought...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look, this place is famous for 
match-making fortunes and stuff. It's 
like... a classic date spot, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Matchmaking...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice, a matchmaking fortune♪ 
Trainer, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"We're obviously a perfect match even 
without a fortune☆ ...but it still sounds 
thrilling!"

In response to Mayano Top Gun's wish, we 
decided to try out a Matchmaking Fortune.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Did you draw your fortune? Show me, show 
Maya too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Waah!! "Lovey-Dovey Straight Ahead"!! 
Yay, yaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yo! A match made in heaven, approved by 
God Himself! Get a room, you two~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~~. Best couple, huh~~~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yep! Thanks, Trainer-chan, Nature-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't mention it~ Thanks for the treat 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even so, Mayano is easy as ever—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nnh... So cute~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh? You think so~? Ehehe~~.

Thanks to the omikuji, Mayano Top Gun 
seemed completely back to her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: F...'Fairly good friends'... !?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A bit... like that... Just what... is 
"like that"...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no! 'Decent' is actually pretty 
tough, you know? Look, it means you're 
consistent!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, totally! It's just a silly 
fortune anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Maya's an adult! I understand 
that kind of stuff, you know!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh! As expected~! Mayano really is the 
most grown-up of all grown-ups~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mm... I know... I know...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Buuut~~~~~~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... Guess that's a no-go after all. 
Yep.

The omikuji result was lackluster, and 
Mayano Top Gun remained in a slump...
